digest.component_or_area: configuration ownership gate (RP-04 S7.3) / multi-subsystem ambient read refactor
propositions: ~110 direct ambient configuration and credential reads (os.getenv, os.environ, load_config) exist below approved composition seams across reconciler, store, snapshot, io, cli, commands, llm/workflow, and MCP server subsystems.
Legacy-exception slice C1 must be drained to empty; every below-seam ambient read must either be cut to compose through the approved seam or registered with exact path+symbol+rationale.

All S1-S6 behavioral suites must pass after each subsystem cutover and after legacy-facade removal, with redacted operation snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except for explicitly recorded approved deltas.

Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient reloads, and migration exceptions must be removed only after their focused suites pass; rollback retains the S1 snapshot-envelope compatibility floor.
